Latin Small Letter E With Acute Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Small Letter E With Acute is 130. Hold Alt, type 130 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Small Letter E With Acute also has the Unicode codepoint U+00E9, so you can type it with Alt+233 on Windows, search for U+00E9 in macOS's Character Viewer, use é in HTML, or \00E9 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Small Letter E With Acute character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity é for Latin Small Letter E With Acute, but the numeric form é is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin small letter e with acute on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 3 0 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Small Letter E With Acute character (é) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin small letter e with acute on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Small Letter E With Acute. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Small Letter E With Acute" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin small letter e with acute in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00E9"; ()
  • Python: \u00E9 or chr(0xE9)
  • JavaScript: \u00E9 or String.fromCodePoint(0xE9)
  • JSON: "\u00E9"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Small Letter E With Acute?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Small Letter E With Acute is 130. Hold Alt, type 1 3 0 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type é without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as é, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+233 not work?

Alt+233 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Small Letter E With Acute?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Small Letter E With Acute is U+00E9. You can use this value in HTML as é, in CSS as \00E9, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type é on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00E9, then click it.
